source: Zensus 2022, Wohnungen nach Fläche der Wohnung (10 m²-Intervalle) und Gebäude mit Wohnraum, 100 m grid, Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder, dl-de/by-2-0
method: kappa: Zensus living area per m² of model living area (A_N / 1.2), non-negative least squares over 300 m blocks of Munich, by house type and storey height h_G; P5–P95 from a bootstrap over blocks. nonres: buildings that are housing only by the size rule (building=yes, cadastre function unspecified or no LoD2) of at least 100 m² living whose 3 × 3 cells would hold more model living than 1 × Zensus + 200 m², taken in ascending order of size; value [Zensus living, model living incl. the building] of those cells, m².

check.munich: model living / Zensus living within Munich
